§6Diesel§f

§aThe workhorse fuel. Generators, flamethrowers, power armor, diesel runs it all.§f

Diesel is a high-grade fuel with §e550 kTU§f and §e1.37 MHE§f per bucket. It is produced by fractioning §bNaphtha§f or §bLight Oil§f.

§6Production§f:
§b• From Naphtha§f: §e100mB§f → §e60mB§f Diesel + §e40mB§f Heating Oil.
§b• From Light Oil§f: §e100mB§f → §e40mB§f Diesel + §e60mB§f Kerosene.
§b• Hydrotreater§f: §e1,000mB§f Cracked Diesel + §e100mB§f Liquid Hydrogen → §e800mB§f Diesel + §e300mB§f Sour Gas.

§6Key Uses§f:
§b• Diesel Generator§f: Burns at §e75%§f fuel efficiency (High grade).
§b• Catalytic Cracking Tower§f: §e100mB§f → §e40mB§f Kerosene + §e30mB§f Petroleum Gas.
§b• Industrial Mixer§f: §e900mB§f + §e100mB§f Reformate → §e1,000mB§f §bHigh-Octane Diesel§f.
§b• Coker Unit§f: §e590mB§f → §e1× Petroleum Coke§f.

§bMister Topaz§f flamethrower (§e100§f ammo per tank), §bChainsaw§f (holds §e5,000mB§f), §bDiesel-Powered Armor§f (§e64,000mB§f per piece, only consumes on damage).

§ePS:§f Diesel is one of the best early-game fuels for power generation. Start stockpiling once your fractioning tower is running.
